'''Piles of Glittering Dust''' are a [[common crafting material]] used to make [[armor]] and [[rare crafting material]]s.

*Purchased from [[material trader]]s.

**Armor crafted with Piles of Glittering Dust (see below).
**See [[:Category:Contains dust]] for other items.
*For known [[creature]]s that [[drop]] Piles of Glittering Dust see [[:Category:Drops dust]].
